said: Yesterday a kirana owner called support because his bank verification kept spinning.
Our weekly report says 1,200 merchants a week abandon at verification.
I watched three drivers call the hub from the same society last Tuesday.
We added six agents last quarter just for manual verification.
Teachers enter the marks in an Excel sheet every Friday.
I personally call about ten parents a week when I remember.
The dashboard showed a 38 percent drop-off on the income-proof step last month.
Last week two of our riders waited forty minutes at the gate because the guard had no entry list.
The support team told me the bank's API times out at peak hours.
My ops head says drivers usually give up after two calls.
I've heard parents complain that they only find out at the monthly meeting.
Someone on the platform team mentioned a parser that broke on scanned PDFs.
The sales guys say merchants find the KYC form confusing.
A customer apparently told our agent the app crashed twice.
Merchants find our onboarding really confusing.
A lot of them drop off, probably because of the bank step.
I think the real issue is that nobody trusts the app.
It must be the address form, it's optional so people skip it.
Weak students fall behind and nobody notices.
Drivers are lazy about reading the address, honestly.
This is costing us a fortune.
The parser is probably why uploads fail.
We'd know it worked if ninety percent of merchants finish verification in the app.
I want every parent to see every score within a day.
Ideally drop-off goes under twenty percent.
We need something that works on the teachers' phones.
The goal is first-attempt delivery for most parcels.
I'd love it if support calls just disappeared.
